facts.headline: Busiest airport on Earth
facts.text: Hartsfield-Jackson is the world's busiest airport: 106.3 million passengers in 2025.
facts.source_title: ACI World: World's Busiest Airports Revealed in Latest Global Rankings (Apr 14, 2026)

facts.headline: The city in a forest
facts.text: Trees covered 45.7% of Atlanta in 2023, down from almost 48% in 2008. The city's goal is 50%.
facts.source_title: AJC: Atlanta's tree canopy has been shrinking (Aug 12, 2026), citing a Georgia Tech study

facts.headline: Born in Atlanta
facts.text: The world's first Coca-Cola was served in Atlanta on May 8, 1886, at Jacobs' Pharmacy.
facts.source_title: Library of Congress: World's First Coca-Cola was Served

facts.headline: Up the street
facts.text: Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. was born in 1929 at 501 Auburn Avenue. You are at 100 Auburn Avenue.
facts.source_title: National Park Service: Birth Home, Martin Luther King Jr. National Historical Park

facts.headline: Wednesday's banquet venue
facts.text: The Georgia Aquarium is the only aquarium in the Western Hemisphere with whale sharks. Their gallery holds over 6 million gallons.

facts.headline: The Centennial Games
facts.text: Atlanta hosted the 1996 Summer Olympics: 10,318 athletes from 197 nations, July 19 to August 4.
facts.source_title: New Georgia Encyclopedia: Olympic Games in 1996

facts.headline: Signal processing was here first
facts.text: ICASSP met in Atlanta on May 7 to 10, 1996, two months before the Olympics.
facts.source_title: ICASSP '96 proceedings record, Atlanta, Georgia, USA, May 7-10, 1996 (dblp / researchr)

facts.headline: Georgia Tech engineering
facts.text: Georgia Tech enrolled 22,405 engineering students in fall 2026, the largest college of its kind in the U.S.
facts.source_title: Georgia Tech College of Engineering: Facts and Rankings

facts.headline: Engineers by the thousand
facts.text: Georgia Tech awarded 5,736 engineering degrees in 2025-26. ASEE ranks it the top U.S. producer of engineering PhDs.
facts.source_title: Georgia Tech College of Engineering: Facts and Rankings

facts.headline: Public health HQ
facts.text: The CDC opened in Atlanta on July 1, 1946. Its headquarters are still here, on Clifton Road.
facts.source_title: David J. Sencer CDC Museum: Our Story

facts.headline: Atlanta University Center
facts.text: Formed in 1929, the Atlanta University Center is the world's oldest and largest group of historically Black colleges.

facts.headline: Where MLSP began
facts.text: MLSP began in Princeton in 1991 as the IEEE Workshop on Neural Networks for Signal Processing.

facts.headline: A new name
facts.text: The workshop took the name MLSP in 2004, in São Luís, Brazil.

facts.headline: Recent MLSP hosts
facts.text: Recent MLSP hosts: Pittsburgh, Espoo, Gold Coast, Xi'an, Rome, London, Istanbul, and now Atlanta.
facts.source_title: IEEE MLSP 2023 Past Workshops; MLSP 2024 call (London, Sep 22-25, 2024); MLSP 2025 site (Istanbul)

facts.headline: This is number 36
facts.text: Istanbul hosted the 35th MLSP in 2025. Atlanta hosts the 36th. The 37th goes to Uppsala, Sweden, in September 2027.
facts.source_title: IEEE MLSP 2025 (35th workshop); IEEE SPS: 2027 IEEE MLSP, Uppsala, Sweden, Sep 13-16, 2027

trivia.question: Which 1965 paper made the fast Fourier transform famous?
trivia.answer: Cooley and Tukey, "An algorithm for the machine calculation of complex Fourier series," 1965.
trivia.source_title: Mathematics of Computation 19 (1965): Cooley and Tukey

trivia.question: In what year did Nature publish Rumelhart, Hinton, and Williams on backpropagation?
trivia.answer: 1986. That is 100 years after the first Coca-Cola was served in Atlanta.
trivia.source_title: Nature 323 (Oct 9, 1986): Learning representations by back-propagating errors

trivia.question: How many Atlanta streets have "Peachtree" in the name?
trivia.answer: 71, says Discover Atlanta. Check the street name before you call a ride.
trivia.source_title: Discover Atlanta: What You Need to Know About Atlanta's Famous Peachtree Streets

mlsp2027.text: See you at MLSP 2027 in Uppsala, Sweden, September 13 to 16, 2027.
mlsp2027.source_title: IEEE Signal Processing Society: 2027 IEEE MLSP

Banquet Dinner at the Aquarium.address: 225 Baker St NW, across from Centennial Olympic Park
